name: Cederberg
terroir: Cederberg is a mountain-range ward roughly 250km north of Cape Town, described repeatedly across sources as home to South Africa's highest-altitude vineyards — Cederberg Private Cellar's own tasting-page listing claims over 1,000m and 'South Africa's highest winery'; Kromrivier's vines are stated to range up to 850m.
